scope: Existing Cage terminal JSON transport connected to a real offline AppContainer cmd terminal; not production backend registration or the full UI
limitations: The separate ConPTY suite measures actual size changes and Ctrl+C; this test proves transport reuse.
Only the home workspace is accepted. Project grants, persistent environment identity, multi-terminal reconnection and frontend routing are not implemented.
cmd was used; no Claude login, interactive Claude TUI, external network or paid API was invoked.
earlierAttempts: The restricted development runner could not create the local AppContainer; rerunning with ordinary host permissions reached the terminal.
